subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should WhatsApp adopt this unconditional 30-second per-chunk inbound-media cutoff as its supported delivery policy?
rationale: Source and proof establish that the guard fixes the indefinite hang, but tests cannot decide whether 30 seconds is the right false-timeout tradeoff for real WhatsApp media delivery conditions.

options.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
options.body: Land the proven channel-local guard because it matches the existing Telegram idle floor and bounds an otherwise indefinite message-delivery stall.

options.title: Retune before merge
options.body: Choose a different channel-owned fixed duration and rerun the same stalled and progressing HTTP proof without adding a new public config key.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
recommendation.body: Land the proven channel-local guard because it matches the existing Telegram idle floor and bounds an otherwise indefinite message-delivery stall.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged WhatsApp connection and delivery lifecycle work makes mcaxtr the strongest available owner for this channel-policy choice.
